title: Sale Contract Review Limits for Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Plans
content:
# Sale Contract Review Limits

For the Payoff and Loan Satisfaction product, a purchase contract submitted on a sale plan is reviewed against the limits below. Plans that involve no sale show 0 or "no".

| Setting | Borrower Voluntary Payoff | HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff | Heir Retention Payoff | Estate Market Sale Payoff | Approved Short Sale Payoff | Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Largest real estate commission allowed out of the sale price (percent of the price) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 6 | 6 | 0.00 |
| Largest other seller closing costs allowed out of the sale price (percent of the price) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 | 3 | 0.00 |
| The buyer must be unrelated to the borrower and successors (arm's length) | no | no | no | yes | yes | no |
| Plan under which a sale to a related party is handled | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | Heir Retention Payoff | Heir Retention Payoff | not applicable |
| Calendar days the property must have been listed before a short sale is approved | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 0 |
| Business days within which a submitted purchase contract or short sale package is reviewed | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5 | 10 | 0 |

### Worked limits on a hypothetical contract

A hypothetical contract price of USD 300000.00 on either sale plan allows a commission of up to 6 percent of the price, USD 18000.00, and other seller closing costs of up to 3 percent of the price, USD 9000.00. Both limits are measured on the contract price itself. The contract price is invented for the illustration.

### Points of judgement

- Only the Estate Market Sale Payoff and the Approved Short Sale Payoff carry commission and other-cost limits, an arm's-length requirement and a contract review period.
- A sale to a related party on either sale plan is handled under the Heir Retention Payoff.
- The 30-day listing period applies to the Approved Short Sale Payoff alone; the Estate Market Sale Payoff has no listing period.
- A contract is reviewed within 5 business days on the Estate Market Sale Payoff and within 10 business days on the Approved Short Sale Payoff.
